svg.title: bandits-wide
svg.text: Every match earns reward and reveals information
Learning better matches also uses capacity needed for future arrivals.
Match arriving users to limited resources
Build policies, then coordinate their execution
1 Represent each resource × period as a bandit arm
Reward observations update the arm’s information state.
2 Decompose with a relaxed linear program
Assemble policies while respecting shared capacities.
